newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai-German Products to issue new shares.
newsitem.headline: Thai-German Products to issue new shares.

text.p: Thai stainless steel pipe producer, Thai-German Products Plc, said on Wednesday it would raise registered capital to 1.54 billion baht ($61.6 million) from 770 million baht by issuing 77 million new shares.
It said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the new shares would be offered to existing shareholders through a one-for-one rights issue at 10 baht per share.
